verdict_rationale: Prospective sample size of N=33 completed matches from Matchday 1 is an initial cohort. Across this cohort, baseline 1X2 accuracy is 60.6% and baseline exact score accuracy is 9.1%. Historical memory successfully prevents false confidence claims (emitting INSUFFICIENT sample for early matches) and avoids performance degradation. However, sample size is below the statistical threshold for declaring an out-of-sample accuracy improvement. Verdict: INSUFFICIENT DATA.
